summary: Kerb beside a retail centre car park; cars already park along it.

drivers.seclusion: East side is a landscaped strip and commercial car park; the nearest homes are 13 m or more away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerb with a row of cars parked along it; room for a van in the line.
drivers.traffic: Side street just off a main road; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along the kerb in Esri, so a van blends in.

flags: Main road noise at the south end
sun_shade: Open kerb; afternoon sun from the west, strip of low planting on the east.

best_section.where: East kerb of Harrys Road, beside the shopping centre car park
